artifacts.summary: Six-phase record-only plan fixing the residue-index modulus convention (P + 1 is the modulus; an instantiation names m with P := m - 1) in LadderModel.lean and the lean extension's source-store note, repairing three 'unrecorded' assertions, and aligning the understated 'dominate' clause across every deliverable surface.

memory_candidates.content: When a task's deliverable is a RECORD (fixing a convention, sharpening a claim), the named deliverable files are a floor, not the blast radius. Grep the claim's wording across the repository before scoping: this project transcribes the same prose claim into a module docstring, a directory README row, a narrative section, docs/theorem-index.md, and a gate script's comment block. docs/theorem-index.md declares itself authoritative ('If two of them disagree, this page is right'), so fixing a claim anywhere else without fixing that ledger leaves the declared-authoritative surface carrying the superseded wording. A one-site fix to a multi-site transcription is worse than none, because it converts a uniform understatement into an unlabelled contradiction.
